status: Revision B CAD implementation; procurement, shared machine mounting and physical qualification remain open

motor.name: STEPPERONLINE 34HS31-6004S1
motor.cad_transform: STEP X/Y -> PCB X/Y; STEP Z - 79.5 -> CAD Z; front shaft points away from PCB
motor.front_hole_note: STEP centers give 69.5 mm pitch, within the drawing 69.6 +/- 0.2 mm. Use drawing tolerances for fabrication.
motor.rear_rotating_shaft_access: Unconfirmed: single fused STEP envelope shows a central recess, not an identified rotating shaft end or an approved attachment bore.
motor.rear_case_screws: Existing case fasteners are not approved accessory threads. Do not remove/replace them without manufacturer confirmation.

mount.concept: Four selected 80 mm front-flange posts, custom 3 mm adapter plate, 6 mm PCB spacers and M4 through-fasteners. No rear motor case screws are used.
mount.adapter_material: 6061-T6 aluminum; bonding/isolation and fastener contact require mechanical/electrical review
mount.long_post_thread: M5 x 0.8 female/female; 10 mm engagement capacity each end, NBK SHBS-M5-80

cable_support.material: PA12, prototype only; temperature/creep and pull-load qualification pending
cable_support.note: Custom printed support with split jacket saddle; bracket itself does not establish strain-relief qualification.

encoder.sensor: Optional U18 AS5047P, bottom side at PCB origin; U18/C52/C53 doNotPlace
encoder.reason: QSH-specific pilot, shaft holder and magnet stack withdrawn. Manufacturer confirmation of rotating rear-shaft access is required before a new attachment and working gap can be defined.

unresolved: Shared front mounting interface, post end design, fasteners, tolerances, stiffness and tool access require approval
Motor body is 79.5 mm in STEP but 80 mm maximum in drawing; full tolerance stack remains to be reviewed
Rear rotating-shaft access and magnet attachment are not established; no encoder hardware is modeled
6 A/phase must be translated to an approved driver current/hold waveform; external load inertia and stop profile remain unknown; manufacturer rotor inertia is 1400 g cm²

connector_body_clearances.basis: Complete projected supplier CAD envelope; top-entry B4P-VH connector body must remain inside the board perimeter.
